score_change_reason: Round 2 added stronger downside evidence than upside: tail 3F redundancy is empirically extreme (0.87-0.93), tail factors weaken in crisis (crisis_ratio < 1), and Q07 is saturated across multiple candidates at portfolio level. This increases the probability that H_1681 collapses into concentrated single-factor behavior.

agreements.point: I agree that D47/D48/D45 are too collinear to justify a 3-factor sleeve; this directly supports my concern that the tail block can become a pseudo-single-factor overlay with weak diversification value.
I agree on the Q07 cross-strategy concentration warning; one-of-four admission control is necessary because simultaneous Q07 anchors would dominate portfolio behavior.
I agree that crisis_ratio below 1 for all tail factors implies the tail sleeve is not truly crisis-amplifying defense, increasing dependency on Q07 and reintroducing L-112-style fragility.

rebuttals.point: I disagree with the implicit optimism from high standalone ICIR and low pairwise Q07-tail correlation as sufficient validation. Those are not portfolio-level or regime-conditional guarantees; stress correlation can rise sharply, and without walk-forward/sub-period constraints this remains vulnerable to sample-conditioned overfit.

I disagree with near-admission framing based on gap alignment. Strategic fit does not offset unresolved implementation and robustness risks (fixed 40/60, PIT ambiguity, concentration dominance). Governance alignment should not outrank failure-mode evidence.

strongest_opposing_argument: The strongest challenge to my position is Quant’s measured low cross-family correlations (Q07 vs D47/D48/D45 around 0.05-0.07) combined with Q07 ICIR 0.929, which directly argues the design may have genuine diversification and signal strength.
kill_scenarios_update: New: (1) Portfolio-level Q07 saturation across H_1681/H_1675/STR_1679/H_1677 causes Herfindahl spike and synchronized drawdown under Q07 regime failure. (2) Signal-construction mismatch (Z_Score_Aligned not physically present in DB) creates research-live drift, producing hidden implementation alpha decay and unstable risk controls.
